title: Integrated multi-omics profiling reveals dynamic regulation of light-induced chloroplast biogenesis in Brassica napus seedlings.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Read the open-access full text (methods, data availability). The Europe PMC supplementary-file endpoint timed out at 120 s, so the supplement was not retrievable. The iProx (Chinese proteomics repository) project page IPX0015290000 returned only a JavaScript-rendered shell with no file list. The GSA (Genome Sequence Archive) page CRA037016 returned a browser-verification challenge, which I did not try to get around.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Design: one cultivar (ZS11), 5 time points (0, 0.5, 2, 6, 12 h of light), biological replicates. Counts: 44,185 expressed genes, 12,817 proteins, 38,291 modification sites on 8,006 proteins. Deposits: raw RNA reads (GSA CRA037016) and raw mass-spectrometry data (iProx IPX0015290001-4). No processed matrix was mentioned as deposited.

a1_downloadable.note: Deposits are raw sequencing reads (GSA) and raw mass-spectrometry files (iProx), which the project rules forbid downloading. The GSA page sits behind a browser check, the iProx listing would not render, and the supplement could not be retrieved. No processed table was verified.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: There is no outcome column. Any target, such as protein level from mRNA level or modification-site change over time, would have to be built by joining transcript, protein and modification tables across 5 time points. Checked only from the paper text.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not verified. No processed expression or abundance matrix was found. Sequences would need lookups against the B. napus ZS11 reference genome.

a4_units_stated.note: Paper text only: FPKM (fragments per kilobase per million reads) for RNA and median-normalised intensity ratios for proteins.

a5_enough_rows.note: About 12,817 genes have both mRNA and protein (paper text), but there are only 5 time points from one cultivar and one condition. The independent unit is the sample, which numbers in the tens.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; processed tables, if found, would likely be under 100 MB

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not compare: no files were opened.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any label would come from a measurement (RNA sequencing or mass-spectrometry quantification), not from another model's output.

honest_claim_h3: At best, the model would predict protein or modification-site changes from mRNA changes in one rapeseed cultivar over a 5-point light time course, with no data from other conditions.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use mRNA levels over a light time course to predict protein abundance and modification changes in rapeseed seedlings.
plain_idea.train_on: For each gene: transcript levels at 5 time points, plus sequence features. Up to about 12,817 genes have protein data (paper's count; not verified).
plain_idea.predict: Protein abundance or modification-site level at each time point, measured by mass spectrometry in the same seed leaves (cotyledons).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Plant biologists studying chloroplast development want to know which genes are controlled after the mRNA stage. However, one cultivar and 5 time points give little that would hold up elsewhere.

ml_idea: Predict mRNA-to-protein lag, or which genes are regulated by modifications, from paired transcriptome and proteome time series. Abandoned because no processed tables were reachable and the label would have to be constructed.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Get the NAR supplementary tables and check whether a gene-by-time matrix of FPKM values and protein intensities exists.

verdict_reason: Fails A1, A2, A3, A5 and A7. Only raw reads and raw mass-spectrometry data are deposited, and no processed table was reachable. There is no ready label column, and the experiment is one cultivar over 5 time points, a mechanistic study rather than an ML dataset.
